# [TASK] Implement Config Service (Spring Cloud Config)

## Task
Spring Cloud Config Server for centralised configuration. Serves per-service,
per-environment YAML to the backend services over HTTP.

## Scope
Git-backed config and encryption at rest were in the original spec and were
dropped. See Notes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The server listens on 8888 and `/actuator/health` returns UP
      (`ConfigServerIntegrationTest`)
- [x] It serves per-service, per-profile config from the classpath `native`
      backend, and the served content is asserted, not just the status code
      (`ServedConfigurationContentTest`)
- [x] No secret is written into a config file. Values arrive as `${ENV_VAR}`
      placeholders, the shape Kubernetes Secrets fill
      (`grep -rc '\${' backend/config-service/src/main/resources/config/`
      returns 39 across the served files)
- [x] It registers with Eureka (`ConfigServerIntegrationTest`)
- [x] The context loads (`ConfigServiceApplicationTests`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 6

## Notes
Implemented 2025-11-15 in `6539256`, `551c53a`, `47e21f8`, `acf825e`. The
`closedAt` date reads 2026-07-28 because the issue was closed later in a
hygiene sweep, not because the code landed then.

Git backend and encryption dropped per ADR-005: the server runs in `native`
mode and is not deployed to Kubernetes, so a Git backend would serve a
component that does not exist there, and encrypting values that are replaced
by environment-variable placeholders encrypts data about to be discarded.

`ServedConfigurationContentTest` came later, from #242.
